about: Regression groups of the new series (docs/new-series-evaluator.md section 5): every public characterization test is in exactly one group, a group is the set of tests that guard one contract, and a group with at least one failed test is one regression, charged once.

manifest 2: the e-mail of an account is not case sensitive
manifest 2: an inactive account cannot log in
manifest 2: a session ends after thirty idle minutes
manifest 2: the dashboard shows each role its own summary
manifest 2: a password change keeps the password policy
manifest 2: an admin creates a resident who can log in
manifest 3: the mobile app gets a token and its user
